comment: S_unexplored is a tilde. The story window and the inventory menu leave blanked unexplored cells; Ctrl-R at the loot direction prompt reaches cmd.c getdir()'s docrt_flags(docrtRefresh), whose redraw_map() calls print_glyph() for every gg.gbuf cell and so prints the tilde again on every unexplored cell show_glyph() has written.
